segments.name: Retail
segments.description: Fashion specialty stores offering apparel and accessories at low prices in junior, missy, plus and family sizes.
segments.evidence: The Company has two reportable segments — the operation of a fashion specialty stores segment ("Retail Segment") and a credit card segment ("Credit Segment"). The fashion specialty stores operate under the names "Cato," "Cato Fashions," "Cato Plus," "It's Fashion," "It's Fashion Metro," "Versona " and "Cache," including e-commerce websites.

segments.name: Credit
segments.description: Credit card and layaway programs enabling customers to purchase merchandise from retail stores.
segments.evidence: The Company has two reportable segments — the operation of a fashion specialty stores segment ("Retail Segment") and a credit card segment ("Credit Segment").

revenueModel.text: Retail segment generates revenue from merchandise sales; Credit segment generates revenue from finance charges and late fees on customer credit accounts.
revenueModel.evidence: Credit and layaway sales under the Company's plan represented 6% of retail sales in fiscal 2025.
